name: Tinsukia

queries.query: Tinsukia Assam official cadastral map parcel land records GIS Assam Bhunaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Assam Bhunaksha viewer, the Assam Integrated Land Records Management System, the Directorate of Land Records, and the official Tinsukia district land-information page. The viewer's current JavaScript was inspected and its public administrative, dag, click-info, WMS, and trace-map routes were tested; no safe full parcel polygon was obtained.

queries.result: First-party discovery returned the Assamese-labelled Government of Assam Bhunaksha district/circle/village hierarchy and the same Assam land-record custodian pages. No separate Tinsukia parcel-vector download or anonymous full polygon response was found.

registryBasis: The Government of Assam Revenue & Disaster Management Department's Bhunaksha is a public cadastral-map viewer integrated with Assam land records. Its live administrative response resolved district code 18 to TINSUKIA and circle code 180101 to TINSUKIA, with village-level codes. The Assam Directorate of Land Records and ILRMS pages identify the state land-record/cadastral custodian. This evidences a public registry/map workflow, not verified citywide polygon coverage.

requests.outcome: TLS-verified viewer HTML loaded; it referenced the current JavaScript bundle /assets/index-qVUqnX9k.js.

Current viewer JavaScript inspected. It exposed /proxy/districts, /proxy/circles, /proxy/villages, /proxy/getAllDagsFromDharitree, /proxy/click_info, /proxy/getDagInfoFromDharitree, /proxy/wms and /proxy/wms/capabilities, plus the state API WMS route.
Anonymous JSON list returned district code 18 as তিনিচুকীয়া (TINSUKIA).
Anonymous JSON returned circle 180101 as তিনিচুকীয়া (TINSUKIA), plus Doomdooma, Margherita and Sadia circles.

Anonymous JSON returned the Tinsukia circle's village/location-code hierarchy, including urban/town-labelled entries such as BORDUBI TOWN and MAKUM JUNCTION TOWN. This is administrative coverage evidence only; no parcel geometry was returned.
Authorization required. No token, login, CAPTCHA, or bypass was attempted; no CRS/schema or vector geometry was retained.
Official district site loaded; no parcel feature endpoint was found in this bounded review.
Official Directorate of Land Records page loaded; department/procedure evidence only.
